FORMAT
- Regular season is weeks 0-15. Every week the commissioner picks 4 games; you pick each one against the spread.
- Scoring: 1 point per correct pick (your team covers). No pick = no point. No bonus points, no confidence weights. Tiebreaker games never count for points.
- The line is the home team's adjustment: home covers if home score + line > away score. Negative line = home favored.
- Every line is a half point (whole numbers get moved half a point), so a push can't happen. If a score ever landed exactly on the number, the grading gives it to the away team.
- Lines lock Tuesday 11:00 AM CT (noon Eastern). The line at that moment is what the week is scored against. A game with no line yet keeps the first one posted.
- A game is graded when it goes final with a line on it: the side that covered is recorded as the winner, and the points land then.

DEADLINE AND PRIVACY
- Regular season: all picks for the week lock at the scheduled start of the week's first game, tiebreaker games included. A weather or TV delay doesn't buy more time.
- Playoffs: each game locks at its own scheduled start.
- Everyone's picks stay hidden until they lock, then are revealed at that moment. You can always see your own.
- Picks save automatically; a pick only counts once it is saved. Picks can only be made on that week's slate games. A game with no kickoff time on file can't be picked yet.
- After the lock, only the commissioner can enter or change a pick.

LET THE SLOTS DECIDE (the jackpot)
- Instead of picking a side, you can choose "Let the slots decide". At lock, the site flips a coin and picks a side for you.
- Every slots pick is one pull on the league jackpot (the football); flipping a pick back and forth doesn't add pulls. If it pops on your pull, you get an AUTO WIN: a point for that game no matter who covers, scored when the game is graded.
- Regular season: the football pops at most once a season. Its odds rise as the season's slots picks run out (never above 5% a pull); once it has popped, no more regular-season pops.
- Playoffs: the odds start at 0.005% a pull and climb after 200 pulls without a pop, up to 10%.
- The jackpot is rare; the current odds are shown on the football on the picks page.

STANDINGS AND PLAYOFFS
- Season standings = total points from weeks 0-15 (correct picks plus slots AUTO WINs). Tiebreaker games and playoff games never count toward them. The site lists no weekly prize.
- Who makes the playoffs: the top 4 in season points after week 15. A tie for 4th place goes to the regular-season tiebreakers (see TIEBREAKERS). The leaderboard draws the projected playoff line from week 9 on.
- The switch: the site moves to the playoffs on its own (the playoff autopilot checks every 10 minutes) once week 15 has all kicked off, every picked regular-season game is graded and 12 hours have passed since week 15's last kickoff. Seeds the commissioner enters by hand always win; the autopilot never touches a season that has them. A tie at the cut that survives every tiebreaker is a coin flip, and the commissioner sets the seeds by hand.
- Seeds 1-4 go by points, then the same tiebreakers. They're cosmetic: the rules never use seeds.
- Playoffs: top 4 advance, scores reset (only playoff games, week 16 on, count), and they pick all playoff games. Each playoff game locks at its own kickoff.
- Who can pick in the playoffs: once the season has its 4 seeds, only those 4 teams can pick playoff games (week 16 on, tiebreakers included). The site and the database both block everyone else ("Only the four playoff teams can make playoff picks."). Eliminated members can still see every game, and every pick once it locks (view only). Before the seeds exist, anyone can still pick. The commissioner can enter or fix anyone's pick.
- Picky (the exhibition player) is never ranked and never takes a playoff spot.
- When: week 15 is conference championship week, the last week of the regular season. The league playoffs start after conference championship week, and the playoff games are the College Football Playoff games. (2025: no pool games the week right after, Army-Navy week; the first playoff games were Dec 19-20.)

PAYOUTS
- Buy-in: $75 per player (confirmed by the commissioner, 2026-11-14; the site itself doesn't print it).
- 1st: the remainder of the buy-in pot. 2nd: buy-in back + $25. 3rd: buy-in back.
- Picky the exhibition player never pays in and never gets paid.

TIEBREAKERS: how ties in the standings are broken. They use separate tiebreaker picks, which never count as points.
Regular season tiebreakers, in order:
1) conference championship game wins
2) Army v Navy
3) chips from The Pit
4) Celebration Bowl
5) win % over the last 8 games
6) coin flip
Playoff tiebreakers, in order:
1) Army-Navy (if unused)
2) regular season points
3) other bowl games
- A tie for the last playoff spot is broken in that order: conference championship tiebreaker picks (the tiebreaker games before the playoffs), then Army v Navy, then chips in The Pit (no Pit row counts as 1,000), then the Celebration Bowl (the tiebreaker game between two MEAC/SWAC schools), then win % over each team's last 8 decided picks.
- A tiebreaker game that isn't graded yet only holds things up if the tied teams picked it differently; if they all picked the same side it can't break the tie and is skipped.
- Still tied after all of that: coin flip. The site never automates it; the commissioner sets the seeds by hand.
- Playoff tiebreakers: Army-Navy counts only if it wasn't already used to set the playoff field.

THE PIT (blackjack, tiebreaker only)
- One shared dealer hand a week. The table opens when the week's picks open and settles at first kickoff.
- Everyone starts the season with 1,000 chips. Bets 25-500 (anything left under 25 is always a legal bet). You bet before seeing any cards.
- Blackjack pays 3:2 rounded down. Dealer stands on all 17s. Double on your first decision only. Dealer blackjack takes original bets only.
- Bust to zero and you're out of The Pit for the season. No reload.
- Chips never become points. They only break ties.

COMMISSIONER
- The commissioner picks each week's games and flags the tiebreaker games, can set lines and enter scores, can enter, change or delete any team's pick at any time, deadline or not, can see every pick before the lock, and enters the playoff seeds.
- Only the house (the site or the commissioner) can mark a jackpot AUTO WIN.
- Playoff autopilot controls (commissioner page): preview the field, pause or resume the autopilot, force the switch now (skips the waiting holds but never decides a coin flip), or undo (removes the season's seeds and pauses the autopilot).
- Anything the written rules don't cover (postponed, canceled or suspended games, disputes): ask the commissioner; it's their call.

EDGE CASES
- Missed the lock: no late picks and no default pick, so no point for that game (only the commissioner can enter one).
- A pick'em (0) line gets moved to +0.5 or -0.5 like any whole number.
- Postponed, canceled or suspended games: the written rules don't say. Ask the commissioner.
- Picky (the exhibition player) can't be ranked, can't win money and isn't in the pot.
- Weeks run Tuesday to Monday around the Saturday; January and February games belong to the previous season.
